Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 l_temp number := 0;
begin
 IF :control_block.value is not NULL THEN
 if :lv_period = 'D' then
 if :lv_opr = '+' then
 :cal_date := :cur_date + :value;
 else
 :cal_date := :cur_date - :value;
 end if;
 :cal_day := :cal_date;
 elsif :lv_period = 'W' then
 if :lv_opr = '+' then
 :cal_date := :cur_date + (:value*7);
 else
 :cal_date := :cur_date - (:value*7);
 end if;
 :cal_day := :cal_date;
 elsif :lv_period = 'M' then
 if :lv_opr = '+' then
 :cal_date := add_months(:cur_date, :value);
 else
 l_temp := 0 - :value;
 :cal_date := add_months(:cur_date, l_temp);
 end if;
 :cal_day := :cal_date;
 else
 if :lv_opr = '+' then
 :cal_date := add_months(:cur_date,(:value*12));
 else
 l_temp := 0 - (:value*12);
 :cal_date := add_months(:cur_date, l_temp);
 end if;
 :cal_day := :cal_date;
 end if;
 END IF;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 date_diff number;
 lastdate date;
 tempdate date ;
 V_from_date date;
 V_to_date date;
BEGIN
 IF :control_block.from_date is NOT NULL 
 AND :control_block.to_date is NOT NULL THEN
 IF :control_block.from_date > :control_block.to_date THEN
 V_to_date := :control_block.from_date;
 V_from_date := :control_block.to_date;
 ELSE
 V_to_date := :control_block.to_date;
 V_from_date := :control_block.from_date;
 END IF;

 tempdate := to_date(to_char(V_from_date,'DD')||
 to_char(add_months(V_to_date,-1),'MM')||
 to_char(V_to_date,'YYYY')
 ,'DDMMYYYY'); 

 date_diff := Months_Between(V_to_date,V_from_date);

 :control_block.year_diff := trunc(date_diff/12);
 :control_block.mon_diff := trunc(mod(date_diff,12));

 IF to_char(V_to_date,'DD') >= to_char(V_from_date,'DD') THEN
 :control_block.day_diff := to_char(V_to_date,'DD') - to_char(V_from_date,'DD');
 ELSE
 lastdate := LAST_DAY(tempdate);
 :control_block.day_diff := to_char(V_to_date,'DD') +( to_char(lastdate,'DD') - to_char(tempdate,'DD'));
 END IF;
 :control_block.no_of_days := (V_to_date - V_from_date)||' Day[s]';
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_CAL_DAYS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_cal_days (curblk in VARCHAR2,yearmonth in VARCHAR2)IS
 FirstItemName varchar(60) ;
 Day VARCHAR2(3) ;
 TotDays number ;
 Counter number ;
 PrevItemName varchar2(80) ;
 NextItemName varchar2(80) ;
 FirstDay number(2) ;
 goal number(6) ;
 pdraw number(6) ;
BEGIN
/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 This program unit populates the calendar. Explanation of inputs are :

 curblk : Block name which will be populated. Right now, only CAL_BLK1, CAL_BLK2 and 
 CAL_BLK3 are valid values.
 yearmonth : Month and year for which this block will be populated. yearmonth SHOULD BE 
 IN 'MMYYYY' format
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

 --go_block(curblk) ;
 --clear_block ;
 counter := 1;
 FirstItemname := get_block_property(curblk, first_item);
 Nextitemname := curblk || '.' ||FirstItemName;
 while counter <= 35
 loop
 set_item_property(Nextitemname,LABEL,' ');
 NextItemName := get_item_property(NextItemName,nextitem);
 NextItemName := curblk || '.' || NextItemName;
 counter := counter + 1;
 end loop; 
 --init_properties(curblk) ;

 /* Get the first day of the month */
 Day := to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'DY') ;
 /* Get total number of days in the month */
 TotDays := to_number(to_char(last_day(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY')),'DD')) ;

 /* Go to the first item */
 FirstItemName := curblk||'.'||get_block_property(curblk,FIRST_ITEM);
-- go_item(FirstItemName) ;
 if form_failure then
 message('Failed to go to first item,contact IS') ;
 end if ;


 /* Decide which item holds the first day of the month */
 if Day = 'SUN' then FirstDay := 1 ;
 elsif Day = 'MON' then FirstDay := 2 ;
 elsif Day = 'TUE' then FirstDay := 3 ;
 elsif Day = 'WED' then FirstDay := 4 ;
 elsif Day = 'THU' then FirstDay := 5 ;
 elsif Day = 'FRI' then FirstDay := 6 ;
 elsif Day = 'SAT' then FirstDay := 7 ;
 end if ;

 Counter := 1 ;
 NextItemName := FirstItemName; 
 while Counter < FirstDay loop
 NextItemName := get_item_property(NextItemName,nextitem);
 NextItemName := curblk || '.' || NextItemName;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;

 Counter := 1 ;

 while Counter <= TotDays loop
 set_item_property(NextItemName,LABEL,to_char(Counter)) ;
 NextItemName := get_item_property(NextItemName,nextitem);
 IF NextItemname is null THEN
 NextItemName := get_block_property(curblk, first_item);
 END IF;
 NextItemName := curblk || '.' || NextItemName;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
 
 /* Do not allow navigation to items which are not
 relevant to the current month */
-- go_block(curblk) ;
 Counter := 1 ;
 -- go_item(FirstItemName) ;
 NextItemName := FirstItemName;
/* while Counter <= 35 loop
 set_item_property(NextItemName,MOUSE_NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 if name_in(NextItemName) is null
 then
 set_item_property(NextItemName,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 else
 set_item_property(NextItemName,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 end if ;
 NextItemName := get_item_property(NextItemName,nextitem);
 IF NextItemname is null THEN
 NextItemName := get_block_property(curblk, first_item);
 END IF;
 NextItemName := curblk || '.' || NextItemName;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
*/
 /* Do not allow navigation--- till here */

 if upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK1' then
 :monthname := rtrim(to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH'))||' '||
 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');
 end if ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GO_UP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE go_up IS
 dest_item varchar2(20) ;
BEGIN

 if substr(:system.trigger_item,13,1) = '1' then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 else
 dest_item := substr(:system.trigger_item,1,12)||
 to_char(to_number(substr(:system.trigger_item,13,1))-1) ;
 end if ;
 if get_item_property(dest_item,NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' then
 go_item(dest_item) ;
 end if ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GO_DOWN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE go_down IS
 dest_item varchar2(20) ;
BEGIN

 if substr(:system.trigger_item,13,1) = '5' then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 else
 dest_item := substr(:system.trigger_item,1,12)||
 to_char(to_number(substr(:system.trigger_item,13,1))+1) ;
 end if ;
 if get_item_property(dest_item,NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' then
 go_item(dest_item) ;
 end if ;

END;
